job_description:
Operations Analytics Analyst

Join the Business Operations team to make service performance easier to understand and improve. You will define operational metrics, investigate data-quality issues, and give leaders practical reporting for weekly decisions.

Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years of analytics or business-operations experience.
- Advanced SQL and experience building recurring business reporting.
- Experience defining operational metrics and investigating data-quality issues.
- Experience presenting findings to non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience building dashboards in Looker.

Preferred Qualifications
- Python for analysis and automation.
- Experience with Tableau.
- Experience with Snowflake.
